summary.text: Dawn Keefer is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania Senate for the 31st District, to which she was elected in November 2024.
She previously served in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 2017 to 2024 and chairs the Senate Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Keefer represented the 92nd Legislative District in northern York County in the House, and her official biography says she helped expose the Commonwealth's "shadow budget" of special funds outside the General Fund.
She was recruited to establish and chair Pennsylvania's Freedom Caucus in the fall of 2022, the biography says.

In the Senate she is vice chair of the Urban Affairs and Housing Committee and a member of the Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, Education, Finance, Intergovernmental Operations, and Law and Justice committees.

The biography says she has more than 27 years of professional and government experience, including more than ten years as a small business owner operating a consulting firm focused on public relations, grassroots strategy, membership development and fundraising.
Her husband, Tom, has owned and operated a custom motorcycle business for more than 20 years.
